info.bio:
Drowning Pool es una banda de nu metal de Dallas, Texas (EEUU) surgida en 1996.

Miembros actuales
    * Jasen Moreno - Vocalista (2012 - presente)
    * C.J. Pierce - Guitarra
    * Stevie Benton - Bajo
    * Mike Luce - Bateria

Ex-Miembros
    * Dave "Stage" Williams - Vocalista (2000-2002)Fallecido Agosto 14 2002
    * Jason "Gong" Jones - Vocalista (2004-2005)
    *  Ryan McCombs - Vocalista (2006 - 2011)

Discos de estudio
* Sinner (2001) RIIA Platino en Estados Unidos

scenes.name: Revival psicodélico y garage de los ochenta
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El revival más persistente de los ochenta y noventa. En Los Ángeles, el «Paisley Underground»: Rain Parade, Three O'Clock, Dream Syndicate (síntesis de Dylan y la Velvet), Savage Republic, True West, Opal. En la Costa Este, los imitadores fetichistas (Lyres, Fuzztones, Chesterfield Kings) y bandas creativas (Das Damen, Plasticland, Eleventh Dream Day). El garage más crudo: Honeymoon Killers, Gibson Bros, Gories, Original Sins, God Bullies, Pandoras. La psicodelia libre de jams: Crystallized Movements, Magic Hour, Vocokesh, Sun City Girls, Black Sun Ensemble, Helios Creed. En Australia, Celibate Rifles, Died Pretty, Hoodoo Gurus, Beasts Of Bourbon, Scientists, Feedtime, Crime And The City Solution; en Europa, Hanoi Rocks, Echo & The Bunnymen, Teardrop Explodes, Bevis Frond, Legendary Pink Dots, The The y Love And Rockets.

podcast.title: Dave Williams' Death on Tour (2002)
podcast.body: On August 14, 2002, during Ozzfest, Drowning Pool's lead singer Dave Williams was found dead in his bunk on the tour bus, having died in his sleep. His death was attributed to cardiomyopathy, a disorder affecting the heart muscle often caused by viral infections or high blood pressure, thus determined to be from natural causes. The band later released a memorial DVD, with proceeds directed towards achieving Williams' dream of buying his parents a house. "He died of something called cardiomyopathy, a disorder that affects the heart muscle caused by things like viral infections or high blood pressure."

xref.title: "The Woman with the Golden Ears" in A&R
xref.body: Meltzer transitioned into A&R, where she gained a reputation as "The Woman with the Golden Ears" due to her exceptional ability to identify and sign hit acts. Her keen ear led her to sign prominent bands such as Creed, Evanescence, Alter Bridge, Finger 11, Drowning Pool, and Bright Eyes. "And because she was so good at picking hit acts, she became known as the Woman with the Golden Ears."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
